tokenisation: control of ud-eng: ud-syntactic-words: CoNLL-U word lines (multiword-token ranges split into their words), UPOS PUNCT dropped, tokens without a letter dropped, lowercase NFC, spaces inside a form joined by _

control of ud-fin: ud-syntactic-words: CoNLL-U word lines (multiword-token ranges split into their words), UPOS PUNCT dropped, tokens without a letter dropped, lowercase NFC, spaces inside a form joined by _

control of ud-spa: ud-syntactic-words: CoNLL-U word lines (multiword-token ranges split into their words), UPOS PUNCT dropped, tokens without a letter dropped, lowercase NFC, spaces inside a form joined by _
control of bk-pride-prej: unicode words: letters, marks, numbers, apostrophes inside words; lowercase NFC; punctuation and pure-number tokens dropped; hyphenated words split
control of bk-moby-dick: unicode words: letters, marks, numbers, apostrophes inside words; lowercase NFC; punctuation and pure-number tokens dropped; hyphenated words split
control of bk-cryptic: unicode words (as other bk pockets); one clue = one unit; clue text only (answer and setter names dropped)

control of oc-irc-ubuntu-0406: word: lowercase NFC maximal runs of letters/marks/digits with inner apostrophes; every token holds a letter (pure numbers dropped); URLs ('://' or leading 'www.') dropped as chunks; no punctuation tokens.

control of oc-cosem: word: lowercase NFC maximal runs of letters/marks/digits with inner apostrophes; every token holds a letter (pure numbers dropped); URLs ('://' or leading 'www.') dropped as chunks; no punctuation tokens. Scrub placeholders {{EMAIL}}/{{TWITTER}} dropped (counted).

control of cd-cc-python: code tokens: maximal runs of letters/marks/digits/underscore, lowercased NFC, NOT split on camelCase or snake_case; numeric literals (a token starting with a digit), tokens containing unspaced-script characters (Han/kana/Thai/...) and tokens longer than 64 characters are dropped; operators and punctuation dropped; comment and string-literal words are kept; unit = physical source line with at least one token

control of cd-cc-json: code tokens: maximal runs of letters/marks/digits/underscore, lowercased NFC, NOT split on camelCase or snake_case; numeric literals (a token starting with a digit), tokens containing unspaced-script characters (Han/kana/Thai/...) and tokens longer than 64 characters are dropped; operators and punctuation dropped; comment and string-literal words are kept; unit = physical source line with at least one token

control of cd-chess-lichess: SAN moves from PGN movetext (tags, comments {..}, variations, move numbers, results, annotation glyphs and +/# check marks dropped); each uppercase letter X written as U+00B7+x so piece moves (Bxc6) differ from pawn captures (bxc6); castling o-o / o-o-o; unit = one game (>= 4 plies)

control of cd-smiles-chembl: SMILES atom tokens only: organic-subset atoms and bracket atoms ([C@@H], [nH], [O-]) as single symbols; bonds, branches, ring-closure digits and dots are punctuation/numbers and are dropped; uppercase letter X written as U+00B7+x (aromatic c vs aliphatic C stay distinct)

control of fm-law-de: lowercase NFC word tokens (maximal runs of letters, combining marks and digits; inner apostrophes kept so French/Italian/Catalan elisions such as l'auteur are ONE token); tokens without a letter dropped; urls and markdown removed
control of fm-pali-dn: lowercase NFC word tokens, IAST diacritics kept; em-dash separates words

control of fm-wlc-torah: lowercase NFC word tokens (maximal runs of letters+combining marks); Hebrew vowel points kept, cantillation marks (U+0591-U+05AF), meteg, rafe and extraordinary points deleted, maqaf and punctuation separate words; no numbers
control of ml-grc-homer: unicode words (letters, marks, digits; apostrophes inside a word kept; zero-width joiners kept inside a word); tokens without a letter dropped; lowercase NFC
control of ml-lat-livy: unicode words (letters, marks, digits; apostrophes inside a word kept; zero-width joiners kept inside a word); tokens without a letter dropped; lowercase NFC

control of ml-lzh-shiji: char-bigram: no source word segmentation exists; NON-overlapping 2-character chunks taken from the start of each clause (a lone final character stays a 1-character token); clauses split at every non-letter; lowercase NFC
control of ml-arb-hadith: unicode words (letters, marks, digits; apostrophes inside a word kept; zero-width joiners kept inside a word); tokens without a letter dropped; lowercase NFC

control of cd-ipa-latn: IPA phones as segmented by the source (space-separated; digraphs, length marks and diacritics stay attached); one unit = one word's pronunciation; first listed pronunciation per word only; any uppercase letter X written as U+00B7+x
